div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FramePacer wait(), --pace=sleep|timer|timer_spin|spin:
absolute deadlines (next += period),
sleep to deadline minus margin (Welford mean + 3 sigma),
spin the remainder; a miss is counted and re-anchored,
never repaid with catch-up bursts

clock_nanosleep TIMER_ABSTIME (Linux),
mach_wait_until (macOS)
